events.headline: IRAN WAR LIVE: TRUMP CLAIMS US IN ‘TOTAL CONTROL’ OF STRAIT OF HORMUZ
events.detail: Qatar says negotiations between Oman, Iran over future of shipping through Strait of Hormuz are making major progress.

events.headline: CARGO SHIP IN FLAMES AFTER HOUTHI ATTACK IN BAB AL-MANDEB STRAIT
events.detail: Footage shows an Egyptian-owned cargo vessel in flames in the Bab al-Mandeb strait after a suspected Houthi attack.

events.headline: US SAYS HELICOPTER FIRED MISSILES TO DISABLE SHIP BREAKING IRAN BLOCKADE
events.detail: US Central Command says its helicopter hit the engine room of a Panama-flagged cargo vessel in the Gulf of Oman.

events.headline: PAKISTAN INTERIOR MINISTER IN TEHRAN AMID TALKS TO REOPEN HORMUZ
events.detail: Pakistan’s interior minister Mohsin Naqvi has held talks with Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi in Tehran.

events.headline: US MILITARY FIRES ON CARGO VESSEL IT SAID SOUGHT TO BREAK IRAN BLOCKADE
events.detail: CENTCOM says helicopter fired at engine room of Panama-flagged Vela Nova as US-Iran diplomacy remains stalled.

events.detail: Tras el fracaso de las conversaciones de paz, la estrategia de Washington pasa por la asfixia económica de Teherán
